caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a man standing on a rectangular black pedestal. His left hand is placed on his hip while his right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand extended forward, holding an object that looks like a horseshoe. The background is plain off-white with no additional objects or significant details, and the focus remains solely on the statue figure in the center of the composition.
title: Hitching Post
